description: This file defines the IndexBuffer class and related classes for managing index buffers in a graphics API, specifically for Direct3D rendering within the ANGLE project. It includes class implementations, methods for buffer management, and buffer reservation strategies.

classes.name: IndexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class managing serial numbers for index buffers.

classes.name: IndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Interface class providing methods to interact with index buffers, including mapping, unmapping, and resizing.

classes.name: StreamingIndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for streaming index buffers with dynamic memory management.

classes.name: StaticIndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for static index buffers with fixed size.

methods.name: updateSerial
methods.description: Updates the serial number for the index buffer.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the index buffer.

methods.name: mapBuffer
methods.description: Maps a portion of the index buffer for writing.

methods.name: unmapBuffer
methods.description: Unmaps the index buffer after writing.

methods.name: reserveBufferSpace
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for new data, resizing or discarding as needed.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the index buffer, initializing if necessary.
